agentId.description: The agent's id, as list_agents answered it.

text.description: What to tell the agent, as the member's own words: it reads them as a message the member typed in its composer.

queue.description: false to steer it into the turn under way, as the composer's ↩ would, or start a turn on an idle agent; true to queue it behind the agent's turn, as the composer's ⌘↩ would: it waits unsent, and goes as the member's next message once the turn and every message queued before it are over, at once where the agent stands idle. Any member who may message the agent queues to it.
